newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - June 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - June 25.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Wednesday:

* Lobbyists for the television industry have worked into bills before the U.S. House and Senate a provision that would allow broadcasters to keep indefinitely the additional channel capacity from digital television, while possibly delaying the introduction of HDTV.
* The U.S. Senate voted to increase Medicare premiums for wealthy elderly citizens and to increase the age of eligibility by two years to 67.
* China indicated it would not support efforts to create an international tribunal to prosecute Cambodia's Khmer Rouge leader Pol Pot.
* Hong Kong writers critical of China are staying put even though they are certain to tussle with their communist foes.
* A United Nations official contends that Iraw is still defying an arms ban.
* Florida, long the retirement haven for the elderly, is growing younger.
* A New Jersey teen-ager who gave birth in the bathroom at her senior prom then left the baby boy in a garbage can has been charged with murder.
